checks: Adding one to every pixel leaves all differences unchanged.
proof: For y[j] = x[j+1] - x[j], an equal additive offset cancels algebraically. Translating an interior edge translates the response under the same stride-one weights. The displayed examples were checked exactly.
limits: This is a hand-set filter, not a trained object recognizer. Arbitrary learned filters, padding, clipping and complete networks need not share its offset invariance.
